prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-body player character concept for a high-fidelity Unreal Engine 5 supernatural cyberpunk game, to be reviewed before use as a Meshy 3D modeling reference.
Primary request: "Neon Exorcist": a street-medium wearing an oversized technical jacket, animated talismans, and a holographic spirit mask. Give them neon accents. Combine forbidden software with spiritual rituals.
Subject: ONE original adult human street-medium, lean athletic build, grounded human anatomy, memorable readable silhouette. Oversized charcoal-black technical jacket with a high collar, broad sleeves, layered weatherproof fabric, visible seams, practical buckles and utility pockets. Tapered tactical trousers, sturdy street boots, fingerless technical gloves. A translucent holographic spirit mask floats closely over the face, with an eerie abstract spirit expression and crisp luminous contours; the head shape remains legible underneath. Bright cyan neon piping and restrained hot-magenta accents run along jacket seams, mask, cuffs, and boot details. A small number of rectangular ritual talismans hang from the jacket and belt; several hover near the shoulders as though animated by spiritual energy, with luminous abstract circuit-sigil markings. Their construction mixes physical paper-like strips and holographic surfaces. Small practical ritual-tech modules on the belt. No conventional firearm or large weapon.
Style/medium: polished professional AAA character concept art with believable detailed 3D/PBR materials, cinematic realism with deliberate shape design. Wet technical cloth, matte rubber, brushed metal fittings, transparent emissive holograms. Strong value separation so neon accents remain crisp rather than washing out the outfit.
Composition/framing: a single full-body figure, head and both boots completely visible with generous margins, front-facing with a slight three-quarter turn. Relaxed neutral A-pose, both arms slightly away from the torso, hands clearly visible and separated from clothing, feet apart. Clear unobstructed body proportions for later 3D reconstruction. The character fills most of a portrait composition.
Scene/backdrop: clean subdued slate-gray studio background with a faint grounded floor shadow. Focus entirely on character design; no city scene or extra characters.
Lighting/mood: moody supernatural cyberpunk with soft neutral studio key light that reveals all garment surfaces, restrained cyan and magenta emissive bounce, subtle rim light. Premium detailed material rendering, readable dark clothing, controlled bloom.
Constraints: exactly one character, no duplicate views or inset panels, no text labels, no logos, no watermark, no cropped limbs, no extreme perspective, no smoke covering anatomy, no bulky particle cloud, no scenery competing with the character.
